messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>

Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: evidence tracker + current blockers for SOC 2 / DPA / PEN

Hi Jaime / Acme team,

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Per our MAP we agreed to run weekly checkpoints to close outstanding security and contractual items before procurement sign-off. I pulled the current ownerships into the attached tracker and highlighted open asks where we need customer input. High-level items below: 

- SOC 2: we still need either the Type II attestation or confirmation of timeline for production.
- DPA: legal sent a redline; need confirmation on a couple of data retention clauses.
- Audit logs: Acme requested a tail of access logs for the past 90 days and the ingestion/retention policy.
- Pen test: we need to finalize scope and schedule; vendor suggested May 26–28 as an initial window.

Action requested from you this week: please indicate owners and ETA for the SOC2 attestation and audit-log export. I've put tentative Redwood owners in the tracker as placeholders.

Attachment: MAP-2026-ACME-evidence-tracker.xlsx (Excel, 32KB)

Proposed next steps:
1) Jaime to confirm SOC2 timeline (by Tue 5/19)
2) Acme procurement to confirm any DPA redline concerns (by Wed 5/20)
3) Redwood to confirm pen-test vendor availability and point-of-contact (by Fri 5/21)

I'll follow up with a summary note after we get the first round of responses.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Jaime Cohen <jaime.cohen@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: evidence tracker + current blockers for SOC 2 / DPA / PEN

Monica — thanks for the clear note. Quick answers below and a couple of follow-ups.

- SOC 2: We do not yet have a current Type II attestation for the environment that would cover the integration. Our security team is coordinating with an auditor; ETA currently mid-June. I can escalate, but can't promise an earlier cert.
- DPA: Procurement flagged section 6 (data retention) for us — we prefer a 90-day default for logs for now. Legal will send the annotated redline by EOD Tue.
- Audit logs: attaching an ask list from our security team with exact fields and formats required (timestamp, user_id, action, source_ip, resource). Could Redwood confirm where those fields map in your logging output and whether you can provide a 90-day export in CSV?
- Pen test: SecureAudit has availability 5/26–5/28 for an initial external scan; they asked for a point-of-contact and a quick scope doc.

Attachment: acme-security-questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Can Karthik or Rishi confirm the export format and whether a 90-day CSV is feasible? Also, please share who will be the Redwood POC for pen-test scheduling.

Best,
Jaime Cohen
Senior Information Security Manager
Acme Health
jaime.cohen@acmehealth.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>

Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: evidence tracker + current blockers for SOC 2 / DPA / PEN

Hi Jaime / Monica,

Thanks for the detail, Jaime. Short answers from infra/security side: 

- Audit log export: we can produce a 90-day CSV with the fields listed (timestamp, user_id, action, source_ip, resource). I attached a small extract for format confirmation. We will need an S3 presigned link or secure transfer method — please confirm preferred delivery.
- Retention: Redwood's default audit log retention is 365 days for enterprise Dedicated customers; for hosted customers we can export a 90-day tail on request.
- DPA redline: we'll wait for the annotated legal notes; at a high level we can accept a 90-day default for logs if that meets Acme's legal requirement.
- Pen test POC: Rishi will own vendor coordination on our side and can be cc'd to schedule.

Attachment: audit-log-extract.txt (TXT, 8KB)
